High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[Imperial Arrest Order]] (Endor, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Endor/Endor Dark/Imperial Arrest Order.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeaFRHNTZhT3UzMUE/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Imperial Arrest Order.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,343,036 bytes, SHA-256 <code>759beaa2c77a2b928ff00f33038f75f94b589a1fdc7b89163a1395830957fd36</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular archival face of this card on its article stays [[:File:Endor-D-imperialarrestorder-decipher-archive.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: scan by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
